# v7 TG s123 seed-robustness eval
# 4-way: Base / LoRA-only / TG v7 s123 / v8b-SS s123
# TF + AR modes, GAR-ours + GAR-Dongre
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/turn_residual_gating

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
EVAL_SCRIPT=src/eval_phase2_gar.py
CONV_PATH=data/ultrachat_eval_heldout.json
OUT_ROOT=runs/eval_v7_tg_s123

# ── Auto-detect TG v7 s123 checkpoint ──────────────────────
TG_RUN_DIR=runs/phase2_tg_s123_v7
TG_CKPT=""
for ep_dir in $(ls -1d ${TG_RUN_DIR}/epoch_* 2>/dev/null | sort -t_ -k2 -rn); do
    if [ -f "$ep_dir/gate_params.pt" ] && [ -d "$ep_dir/lora" ]; then
        TG_CKPT="$ep_dir"
        break
    fi
done
if [ -z "$TG_CKPT" ] && [ -f "$TG_RUN_DIR/gate_params.pt" ] && [ -d "$TG_RUN_DIR/lora" ]; then
    TG_CKPT="$TG_RUN_DIR"
fi
if [ -z "$TG_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No TG v7 s123 checkpoint found in $TG_RUN_DIR"
    ls -la "$TG_RUN_DIR"/ 2>/dev/null || echo "  (directory not found)"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Using TG v7 s123 checkpoint: $TG_CKPT"

# ── Auto-detect LoRA-only s123 checkpoint ──────────────────
LO_RUN_DIR=runs/phase2_lora_only_s123
LO_CKPT=""
for ep_dir in $(ls -1d ${LO_RUN_DIR}/epoch_* 2>/dev/null | sort -t_ -k2 -rn); do
    if [ -d "$ep_dir/lora" ]; then
        LO_CKPT="$ep_dir"
        break
    fi
done
if [ -z "$LO_CKPT" ] && [ -d "$LO_RUN_DIR/lora" ]; then
    LO_CKPT="$LO_RUN_DIR"
fi
if [ -z "$LO_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: LoRA-only s123 checkpoint not found in $LO_RUN_DIR, skipping LoRA-only eval"
else
    echo "Using LoRA-only s123 checkpoint: $LO_CKPT"
